mechanism: Isocarboxazid is a non-selective MAOI that can potentiate serotonergic activity and increase cardiovascular effects; raloxifene has estrogen agonist properties that may interact with monoamine oxidase inhibition to increase thrombotic and cardiovascular risk.
action: Monitor closely for signs of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and thromboembolic events; consider alternative antidepressant if possible; ensure adequate patient counseling on dietary tyramine restriction.
